objective: Minimize repeated wind-query cost subject to numerical velocity and coverage targets. Charge offline CFD and table loading separately.
method: At each fixed common-air world position, rotate both training vectors into their wind-aligned frames, linearly interpolate the components in wind-from angle, then rotate back to the requested world frame. Never extrapolate.
cfd_selection: Try the existing production mesh against the strict reference for each training direction. Prefer the cheaper field if it passes the regional fidelity, convergence and source-support checks. A checked strict field can supply the table if the cheaper field cannot qualify. Use an independent strict solve for the holdout.
evaluation: Score the held-out direction at fixed world points. Include every reference-valid point of a scored region in the coverage denominator. Report masked and unsampled positions separately. Retain provisional or failed runs outside the released fields.
interpretation: This directional pilot extends the single-condition coupled study. The study's provisional error and coverage cutoffs are used as engineering targets. No operational flight tolerance has been established.
comparison_methods: Linear blend of world-frame endpoint vectors at the same position
